what_it_does: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service and marketing teams.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via External Client App (recommended); new Connected Apps restricted since Spring '26 (need Salesforce Support). Specific flows (web server, JWT bearer, client credentials) are listed in a Salesforce Help article not opened here, so JWT is not listed as verified.
access_notes: Free Developer Edition org for testing and development (signup at developer.salesforce.com/signup); user profile needs 'API Enabled' permission. Hosted MCP (GA Apr 2026) is stated for Enterprise Edition and above; Developer Edition support for MCP unconfirmed.
api_notes: REST API and SOAP API developer guides confirmed; Bulk/Metadata/GraphQL APIs exist per wider docs but not opened in this pass.

what_it_does: CRM with marketing, sales, service and content hubs.
auth_notes: OAuth for multi-account (marketplace or private, up to 10 installs); static auth / private-app access token (Bearer) for a single account; developer API key (hapikey) only for some app-level features. Private app tokens need a super admin.
access_notes: Private app tokens work on Free and Starter accounts (100 calls/10s, 250k/day). Developer test accounts are free (90-day enterprise trial features, renewable).
api_notes: CRM objects, associations, marketing, CMS, etc.; app config via HubSpot CLI and app-hsmeta.json on new developer platform.

what_it_does: Pipeline-focused sales CRM for small and mid-size teams.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 recommended for all public apps (access_token in Authorization header); personal API token also exists (docs page 'How to find the API token' linked but not opened).
access_notes: Developer sandbox account requested via form on developers.pipedrive.com, no approval step mentioned; docs do not explicitly state it is free. Sandbox deleted if no app created within 45 days or not published/live within 6 months; a community thread reports sandbox closures and a paywall.
api_notes: Public REST API (v1/v2) covering deals, persons, organizations, activities etc.; breadth inferred, reference not opened in detail.

what_it_does: Flexible, data-driven CRM with custom objects and lists.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 for multi-workspace apps; workspace API key (scoped access token) from app developer settings for single workspace. Sent as Bearer (Basic also supported).
access_notes: Developer page has 'Start for free'; auth docs list no plan requirement. Free-plan API eligibility not explicitly confirmed (pricing page not opened).
api_notes: REST API with read/write on objects, records, lists plus webhooks; breadth estimate not verified against full reference.

what_it_does: Open-source CRM, self-hostable or cloud, with custom data model.
auth_notes: API key created under Settings > Developers > API, sent as Bearer; can be role-scoped. OAuth available for external apps acting on behalf of users.
access_notes: Open-source core free to self-host; cloud has free trial without credit card (length not stated).
api_notes: Core API (record CRUD) and Metadata API (schema) in both REST and GraphQL; 100 req/min, batches of 60. Cloud base https://api.twenty.com/.

what_it_does: Customizable work-management and collaboration platform with app builder.
auth_notes: OAuth2 server-side, client-side, username/password and app-authentication flows; requires registering an API key (client_id/secret) in account settings.
access_notes: FAQ: free and paid accounts get full API access at same base rate limits. Free plan up to 5 users but limited to 100 items per org. Some destructive ops need raised trust level via support.
api_notes: REST API across apps, items, workspaces, tasks, files, comments etc.

what_it_does: Full-featured CRM for sales automation, pipelines and customer management.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0; register client at api-console.zoho.com (server-based, client-based, self client, mobile). Access tokens 1h, refresh tokens until revoked. Multi-datacenter domains.
access_notes: API limits doc lists Free edition with 5,000 credits/24h; trial editions get same limits as paid equivalents. Feature list per edition not opened, so Free API access is implied rather than stated.
api_notes: V8 REST APIs over modules, records, metadata, bulk, notifications; credit-based limits per edition.
